tasks.short: Verify shipment documents against customs, insurance and regulatory requirements.

steps.what: Read the shipment documentation for customs and insurance
Read mail about customs and insurance requirements
Read the shipment fields the requirements use
Compare shipment fields with customs and insurance requirements
Decide adherence of the documents to regulatory requirements
Record the accepted adherence result on the shipment
Speak with the insurer about an insurance requirement

tasks.design: The {OPS_SYSTEM} compares consignee, goods description, weight, value and insurance amount already stored on the shipment with the mandatory fields for that lane, and lists the gaps. The freight forwarder reads the {DOCS}, decides whether the documents meet the requirements, and records the accepted result on the shipment. The call with the insurer stays a conversation.
tasks.previous_blocker: The forwarder ticked the fields by eye, and insurance wording was not a column on the shipment.
tasks.enabler_now: Those shipment fields are already stored, so a plain compare needs no model and no new capture beyond the read that already happens.
tasks.still_hard: A requirement that is not a stored field, especially insurance wording, still needs the forwarder and sometimes the insurer.
tasks.human_edge: Only the forwarder can say that a document meets a requirement the stored fields do not hold.
tasks.altitude: The field-by-field tick goes away. The forwarder still decides adherence and still speaks with the insurer.

reach.learn: Which missing field actually blocks a declaration.

evidence.claim: A shipment record that already stores consignee, goods description, weight, value and insurance amount can be compared with the mandatory fields for that lane. No model is used.
Abroad, a driver may still need a paper consignment note, so the document read stays in this task.
In a vendor customs case, brokers accepted the top code suggestion unchanged 87 percent of the time.

assumptions: Prompt means are screens 32.6, spreadsheets 7.0, mail 14.6, documents 38.1 and meetings 7.7, which sum to 100. Largest remainder gives screens 33, spreadsheets 7, mail 14, documents 38 and meetings 8. This work uses the shipment record, not a workbook, so the 7 spreadsheet points sit on screens: screens 40, documents 38, mail 14, meetings 8.

The compare reads consignee, goods description, weight, value and insurance amount. The lane's mandatory fields are columns already on the shipment. No person keeps a separate field list for this task, so upkeep is zero. A missing column is handled in the check.
The producer of the fields is the shipment record itself. Where a field is blank, the forwarder reads the document. That read is s1 and is not removed.
The adherence result is the shipment result. It does not score the forwarder, and no view is built to watch staff.
The vendor case is why this design does not propose a code. The 87 percent is not a share of this task and is not used in the range.
Declaring the goods, and submitting transport information to an authority, are other tasks and are not timed here.
unknowns: Whether each lane already stores its mandatory customs and insurance fields.
How often the insurer call is needed for this check.
research_questions: Which lanes store the mandatory customs and insurance fields on the shipment?

already_counted.description: The adherence decision is the whole of the check step and is not extra upkeep.

incremental.description: No person keeps a field list for this compare. Mandatory fields are already columns on the shipment, so there is no steady upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is a lane with no stored requirement list, so the forwarder compares by hand and the saving is zero. High keeps the field compare and drops about six points because insurance wording is not a stored field. Both figures are assumptions, not a count of shipments.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep current knowledge of legislation and politics that affect freight shipping.

steps.what: Read legislation and political reports that affect freight shipping
Read mail about legislation and political situations
Read official notices that could affect freight shipping
Discuss political situations that could affect freight shipping

tasks.design: The freight forwarder still reads legislation in {DOCS}, mail in {EMAIL}, and the text of official notices on the {GOV_PORTAL}, then discusses which situations could affect a lane. A stored country does not decide which political item matters, so the reads stay as they are.
tasks.previous_blocker: Whether a notice changes a booking is a judgement about that lane, not a field a screen can filter.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes that judgement. The notices are already published for the forwarder to read.
tasks.still_hard: Telling a notice that changes a lane from one that does not.
tasks.human_edge: The forwarder knows which political item changes a live booking. A country code on the shipment does not.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The week still includes reading legislation and talking through political situations.

reach.task: Watch a lane for a rule change
reach.learn: How to tell a notice that changes a booking from one that does not.

evidence.claim: Keeping current on legislation and political situations is reading and judgement. No tool in this task selects which notice matters.

assumptions: Prompt means are screens 19.9, spreadsheets 5.3, mail 17.8, documents 40.9 and meetings 16.0, which sum to 99.9. Largest remainder gives screens 20, spreadsheets 5, mail 18, documents 41 and meetings 16. Legislation is not kept in a workbook, so the 5 spreadsheet points sit on documents: documents 46, screens 20, mail 18, meetings 16.
The shape prior leans to a desk that replies to questions. Nobody asks a question in this task, so that shape is rejected. The work is the reading itself.
A filtered list of notices is rejected. A stored lane country does not decide which political item matters, so each notice read stays at full time.
No change note is written today, so none is added. The briefing is a conversation with colleagues and is not a record sent outside.
No separate notice list is maintained, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Which notices this forwarder actually opens in a week.
Whether the briefing is with colleagues only, or sometimes with a customer.
research_questions: Which official notices change a booking on this forwarder's lanes?

incremental.description: No notice list is kept. The forwarder reads the notices, so there is no steady upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The legislation read, the mail, the notice read and the discussion stay at full time, because a stored country does not decide which political item matters. Saving is zero on both ends.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend or arrange packing for climate, terrain, weight, goods and costs.

steps.what: Read the goods weight and the route climate and terrain
Read notes on the nature of the goods
Recommend a packing method for the climate and the costs
Write the packing method onto the shipment
Arrange the packing by sending the method to the packer

tasks.design: The freight forwarder reads weight, climate and terrain on the {OPS_SYSTEM} and the nature of the goods in {DOCS}, then recommends a packing method for the climate and the costs. The accepted method is written on the shipment and sent to the packer from {EMAIL}. An earlier packing code is not copied, because the goods and the route are the choice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Climate, terrain, weight and the nature of the goods change together, and no stored code selects the method.
tasks.enabler_now: The shipment already holds weight and route. That does not remove the choice of method.
tasks.still_hard: Matching a method to fragile goods, a hot or wet route, and the cost the customer will accept.
tasks.human_edge: The forwarder judges the method. A previous code for a similar commodity skips the climate and the goods.
tasks.altitude: Nothing is shortened. The forwarder still chooses the packing method, writes it, and arranges it with the packer.

reach.task: Choose packing for a special cargo
reach.learn: How climate and the goods change the method.

evidence.claim: The packing method depends on the goods, the climate, the terrain and the cost of that shipment. Copying an earlier packing code would skip that choice.

assumptions: Prompt means are screens 26.7, spreadsheets 6.6, mail 18.4, documents 26.9 and meetings 21.4, which sum to 100. Largest remainder gives screens 27, spreadsheets 7, mail 18, documents 27 and meetings 21. Weight and route sit on the shipment record, not a workbook, so the 7 spreadsheet points sit on screens: screens 34, documents 27, mail 18, meetings 21.
The recommendation in the meeting is spoken to the customer and is not a gated release. The shipment write and the packer send are the releases, and both use that same accepted method.
Copying last year's packing code is rejected. The goods, the climate and the route are the selection, and that choice stays at full time.
No packing-code list is kept for this task, so upkeep is zero. The write does not change the accepted method.
unknowns: Whether the recommendation is spoken to the customer, the packer, or both.
Whether a packing code is already a column on the shipment.
research_questions: Who receives the packing recommendation, the customer or the packer?

incremental.description: No packing-code list is kept. The goods, climate and route are read each time, so there is no steady upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The packing choice, the shipment write and the packer send stay at full time. The goods and the route are the selection, so nothing is shortened. Saving is zero on both ends.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Make arrangements with customs brokers so goods pass through customs.

steps.what: Read the customs documents the broker must receive
Read the shipment facts for the customs broker
Copy customs document references into the broker pack
Check the broker pack against the customs documents
Make arrangements with the customs broker by sending the pack
Speak with the customs broker about passage of the goods

tasks.design: The {OPS_SYSTEM} copies document type, number and date already stored on the shipment into the broker pack. The freight forwarder checks that pack against the customs documents in {DOCS}, sends it from {EMAIL}, and speaks with the broker about passage of the goods. The ask to the broker is not a stored status, so the mail is not sent on its own.
tasks.previous_blocker: The forwarder retyped document type, number and date into the pack sent to the broker.
tasks.enabler_now: Those three references are already stored on the shipment, so the second typing is a plain copy. No model is required.
tasks.still_hard: What the broker still needs to hear, and a document that is not already on the shipment.
tasks.human_edge: The forwarder decides which document the broker still has to see, and handles the passage on the call.
tasks.altitude: The second typing of document references goes away. The check, the send and the call with the broker stay.

reach.task: Hand a shipment to a customs broker
reach.learn: Which document the broker still has to see.

evidence.claim: Document type, number and date already stored on a shipment can be copied into a pack list. No model is used.

assumptions: Prompt means are screens 24.5, spreadsheets 3.7, mail 21.7, documents 28.3 and meetings 21.8, which sum to 100. Largest remainder gives screens 24, spreadsheets 4, mail 22, documents 28 and meetings 22. The references live on the shipment record, not a workbook, so the 4 spreadsheet points sit on screens: screens 28, documents 28, mail 22, meetings 22.

The copy uses type, number and date already stored. It does not propose a commodity code. No person keeps a separate pack list, so upkeep is zero. Where a reference is missing, the forwarder assembles that document by hand in the check.
The shape prior treats the broker handoff as automatic. The ask is not a stored status, so the mail stays a person send and the call stays a conversation.
Checking that documents meet customs rules is a different task and is not timed here. The broker, not the forwarder, makes the declaration.
The send does not change the accepted pack. The call is live facilitation and has no separate record.
unknowns: Which document references are already fields on the shipment.
How often the broker wants a document that is not on the shipment.
research_questions: Which document type, number and date are already stored before the broker pack is made?

already_counted.description: The check of the broker pack against the customs documents is the whole of that step and is not extra upkeep.

incremental.description: Type, number and date are already stored. No person keeps a separate pack list, so there is no steady upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is a broker who wants a document that is not on the shipment, so the forwarder assembles the pack by hand. High keeps the reference copy and drops about three points for scans that have no document reference. Both figures are assumptions, not a count.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week keeps the broker calls, the packing judgement and the reading of legislation. The second typing of document references into a broker pack goes away, and the field-by-field tick of a shipment that already holds those fields goes away. The forwarder still decides adherence, still chooses the packing, and still reads the notice.
skills_to_grow: Check a field gap against the document.
Tell whether a notice changes a lane.
Match a packing method to the goods.
role.ambitious_version: The forwarder spends the broker call on the hold, not on retyping document numbers.
